00254 inline float wrap(float in, float lo, float hi) throw()
00255 {
00256  float range;
00257  if (in >= hi) 
00258  {
00259   range = hi - lo;
00260   in -= range;
00261   if (in < hi) return in;
00262  } 
00263  else if (in < lo) 
00264  {
00265   range = hi - lo;
00266   in += range;
00267   if (in >= lo) return in;
00268  } 
00269  else return in;
00270  
00271  if (hi == lo) return lo;
00272  return in - range * std::floor((in - lo)/range); 
00273 }

00302 inline float fold(float in, float lo, float hi) throw() 
00303 {
00304  float x;
00305  float c, range, range2;
00306  x = in - lo;
00307  
00308  if (in >= hi) 
00309  {
00310   in = hi + hi - in;
00311   if (in >= lo) return in;
00312  } 
00313  else if (in < lo) 
00314  {
00315   in = lo + lo - in;
00316   if (in < hi) return in;
00317  } 
00318  else return in;
00319  
00320  if (hi == lo) return lo;
00321 
00322  range = hi - lo;
00323  range2 = range + range;
00324  c = x - range2 * std::floor(x / range2);
00325  if (c>=range) c = range2 - c;
00326  return c + lo;
00327 }

00414 inline float linlin(const float input, 
00415      const float inLow, const float inHigh,
00416      const float outLow, const float outHigh) throw()
00417 {
00418  float inRange = inHigh - inLow;
00419  float outRange = outHigh - outLow;
00420  return (input - inLow) * outRange / inRange + outLow;

00442 inline float linsin(const float input, 
00443      const float inLow, const float inHigh,
00444      const float outLow, const float outHigh) throw()
00445 {
00446  float inRange = inHigh - inLow;
00447  float outRange = outHigh - outLow;
00448   
00449  float inPhase = (input - inLow) * pi / inRange + pi;
00450  float cosInPhase = (float)std::cos((double)inPhase) * 0.5f + 0.5f;
00451  
00452  return cosInPhase * outRange + outLow; 
00453 }

00480 inline float linexp(const float input, 
00481      const float inLow, const float inHigh,
00482      const float outLow, const float outHigh) throw()
00483 {
00484  float outRatio = outHigh / outLow;
00485  float reciprocalInRange = 1.f / (inHigh - inLow);
00486  float negInLowOverInRange = reciprocalInRange * -inLow;
00487  return outLow * pow(outRatio, input * reciprocalInRange + negInLowOverInRange); 
00488 }

00508 inline float linwelch(const float input, 
00509        const float inLow, const float inHigh,
00510        const float outLow, const float outHigh) throw()
00511 {
00512  float inRange = inHigh - inLow;
00513  float outRange = outHigh - outLow;
00514  float inPos = (input - inLow) / inRange;
00515 
00516  if (outLow < outHigh)
00517   return outLow + outRange * std::sin(piOverTwo * inPos);
00518  else
00519   return outHigh - outRange * std::sin(piOverTwo - piOverTwo * inPos);
00520  
00521 }
